source_notes: On 28 Oct 2025 Excelerate Energy signed a definitive commercial agreement (~$450M, 5-yr regas + LNG supply with extension options) with a subsidiary of Iraq's Ministry of Electricity to develop, OPERATE and supply Iraq's first FSRU import terminal at Port of Khor Al-Zubair. Excelerate's role is explicitly the fully integrated operator (construct terminal, deploy vessel, supply LNG, provide regas). GEM Operator was blank. Excelerate Energy is an existing GEM entity (E100002007946/E100002007947).
scope_note: Terminal-asset OWNER left to qa (counterparty is an unnamed Ministry of Electricity subsidiary - ambiguous precise entity).

source_notes: Excelerate will deploy its own newest FSRU (Hull 3407, built by HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, delivery 2026, 170,000 m3, up to 1,000 MMscf/d regas) at Khor Al-Zubair; Excelerate owns the vessel. GEM VesselOwner was blank. FSRU sync touchpoint with the carrier project.

The deployed FSRU is Excelerate's newbuild Hull 3407 (HD Hyundai HI, delivery 2026), not yet given a final vessel name in the announcement. Recorded as 'Excelerate Hull 3407' as a placeholder; update to the final christened name once delivered. Yellow because the permanent vessel name is not yet published.
